verdict.rationale: Kushki's own docs include a step-by-step 'Accept a Card Payment' guide, test data and a 'Moving to Production' page, a JS library, and plain-text/markdown docs (llms.txt, .md pages), so a documented integration path exists. The evidence shows only page titles, though, and nothing on code samples or integration time; no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: evidence of copy-paste code samples in multiple languages/SDKs, evidence that an integration takes under a day, hands-on or independent corroboration, a published OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As a developer, I can integrate a working payment flow from the docs alone in under a day, with copy-paste examples in my language

citations.quote: Librería JS — Máxima seguridad con PCI de Kushki
